evidence: Source review of the launch-parent recheck keeps native build 1 compatible. The only backend edits are in src/planner/server_lifecycle: logic/shutdown.py adds two pure policy helpers, supervisor.py rechecks an unverified launch parent when SIGINT or SIGTERM arrives, and process_identity.py prints why a busctl check failed. These run only in the local supervisor process that owns the server's lifetime. No server route, serializer, payload shape or contract changes, and no Swift source references server_lifecycle. Prior review (pre-Mac pin adoption fix) stands for everything else.
